author: same assistant
text: Workshop analysis: R already funds Libyan cooperation, a public update and protected two-way outreach inside Libya; outside coverage is missing. Extend that existing channel to victims, witnesses, affected communities and representatives outside Libya, and request a line-by-line update on all four inquiries. Outreach and reporting need staff and witness-privacy safeguards; narrower outreach costs less but risks selectivity. This recommendation is not recorded Brazilian endorsement of R or an established future vote.
